A letter, just for you

Dear Meghana,

Today the world gets another reason to celebrate, and the reason is you. Twenty-five years of you means twenty-five years of laughter, courage and kindness that the people around you are lucky to have.

I made this page because a message felt too small for a day like this. I wanted something that lights up, moves and plays you a song, a little like the way you light up a room.

Thank you for the way you make ordinary days feel better. I hope this new year gives you back everything you give away.

Happy 25th birthday, my love. I am right here, cheering the loudest.

With all my love, Suvasis
